# verbose : detailed [ISGATE] diagnostics in UE4SS.log (menu-open / request /
#           reply traces on the client, per-chest + discovery traces on the
#           server). Defaults to ON so any field issue is easy to report with a
#           log. Set to false once everything works to keep the log quiet.
#           Values: true / false
verbose = true

# reconcile_interval_ms : (dedicated server / host only) how often the server
#           re-scans every guild chest from the map-object manager and re-applies
#           the cross-camp merge. Lower = faster to notice a camp being built or
#           dismantled, higher = less background work. Minimum 500.
reconcile_interval_ms = 8000

# isi_refresh_ms : (reserved / config-compat) remote-client refresh cadence.
#           Kept for backward compatibility with older configs. Minimum 200.
isi_refresh_ms = 1500
